verdicts.title: Spikes wrap score below zero into 65136 instead of clamping at 0

Restart from pause menu leaves mode paused while enemies and state reset
HUD shows stale Coins 0/5 after collecting a coin
Game stays paused with no dialog after restart; all input ignored
Toast covers the Resume button in the pause menu
Spikes wrap score below zero (100 - 500 shows 65136, later -300)
Gem pickup wraps score from 65236 to 4700
HUD coin counter stale after coin pickup (shows 0/5 with 1 coin)
Score goes negative (-400, then -800) after spikes and coins
HUD coin counter lags state (Coins 0/5 while coins=1)
